# FinCalc

> FinCalc is a free collection of 47 online financial calculators covering personal finance, investing, loans, retirement, and business finance. All calculators run entirely in the browser — no signup, no data stored.

## Calculators

- [Salary Calculator](https://finclac.com/salary): Convert pay between hourly, daily, monthly, and yearly
- [401(k) Calculator](https://finclac.com/401k): Project 401(k) balance at retirement, including employer match
- [Millionaire Calculator](https://finclac.com/millionaire): Find out what age you'll reach $1,000,000
- [Dollar Cost Averaging Calculator](https://finclac.com/dca): Shares bought, average cost per share, DCA vs lump sum
- [International Transfer Cost Calculator](https://finclac.com/remit): True cost of sending money abroad, including rate markup
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://finclac.com/mortgage): Monthly payment with taxes, insurance, and PMI
- [Loan / EMI Calculator](https://finclac.com/loan): Loan payment schedule and amortization
- [Retirement Planner](https://finclac.com/retirement): Retirement savings projection adjusted for inflation
- [FIRE Calculator](https://finclac.com/fire): Financial independence / early retirement timeline
- [Tax Estimator](https://finclac.com/tax): US federal income tax and effective rate estimate
- [CAGR Calculator](https://finclac.com/cagr): Compound annual growth rate
- [Currency Converter](https://finclac.com/currency): Live exchange rates across 15 major currencies

See [sitemap.xml](https://finclac.com/sitemap.xml) for the full list of calculators and articles.

## Notes

All calculators produce estimates for general informational and educational purposes only, not financial, tax, legal, or investment advice.
